summary: Members return for another day of debate before the chamber has even agreed to take up the bill.
realLife: Russell’s bloc debated Mansfield’s motion to proceed for over two weeks.
gates: The motion to proceed is debatable.
inGame: The legislature tests Senate cloture. needs: a separate motion to proceed and a debate record attached to that motion.

turns.what: The opposition lets the chamber take up the bill and reserves its objections.
turns.pulledBy: Members have agreed to debate the substance on the floor.
turns.writesBack: The motion passes and debate begins on the text.

turns.what: The opponents accept a fixed period for debate on taking up the bill.
turns.pulledBy: Both sides accept a time agreement while keeping their positions.
turns.writesBack: The presiding officer has a time to put the motion.
